derivation: from the same as G3694 (ὀπίσω) (through the idea of backwardness);
def: (adverbially) late in the day; by extension, after the close of the day

occurrences.text: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
And when even was come, he went out of the city.
Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
